summary: stui re-reads its machine list when a connection goes live and when st's live summary counts a different number of machines, so a list cached before a machine joined no longer hides it

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged. The existing machines read is used.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: stui-local behavior only; the daemon, the Swift and TypeScript clients and the wire are unchanged. The machines read stui already made when the Fleet tab opens is now also made on a live connection and when the summary's machine count changes.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work. One extra machines page read per connection and per change in the count.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
